The offices are in the historic Marine Building. Don Muldoon has practised since 1981. In 1982 he and Michael Bolton started the criminal firm Bolton & Muldoon, and that tradition continues. Work includes drug possession, trafficking and production, assault including spousal and sexual assault, Immediate Roadside Prohibitions and Administrative Driving Prohibitions. The firm is based in downtown Vancouver and handles cases throughout British Columbia, and its recent cases include a civil forfeiture matter.

about:
Snow Lawyers is a London trial law firm defending impaired driving, drug, weapons and assault charges across southwestern Ontario.

The firm was established in 2019 and handles over 80, guns and weapons, domestic assault and sexual assault matters. Geoff Snow focuses on complex trials and applications in the Ontario Court of Justice and the Superior Court of Justice, and holds a Master of Laws in criminal law and procedure. The team also includes Danielle D'Alonzo and Delia Matias. The firm keeps clients' privacy in mind and prepares for trials that last from hours to months.

about:
Lakeshore Law is an Oakville firm covering corporate and commercial law, construction, criminal, family and civil litigation, and immigration matters.

Arjun Sekhon graduated from the University of Windsor in 2021 and was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2022, with corporate, commercial, criminal, family and immigration work. Daniel Ibrahim, of counsel, practises litigation before the Ontario Court of Justice and Superior Court of Justice, with municipal, criminal, family and civil work, plus probate applications, wills and powers of attorney. The team has backgrounds in larger firms and in-house roles, and the firm takes on pro bono work and mentorship.

about:
Fox McNevin MacKay LLP is a Windsor family law firm handling divorce, separation, property division, custody, access and support.

Its services include collaborative family law, marriage, separation and cohabitation agreements, uncontested divorce, mediation and arbitration, litigation and appeals. Tanya McNevin earned her law degree from the University of Windsor in 2010, was admitted to the Ontario bar in 2011 and spent ten years in the legal field beforehand. Thomas MacKay and Mary Fox are also part of the team. The firm develops a custom strategy with each client and uses mediation, collaborative processes and litigation.
